text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the Tenno Sho (Spring), she also 
wins the Takarazuka Kinen. Hishi Miracle 
lived up to the expectations of the fans 
who believed in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S remained unfazed, 
stating that those without purpose posed 
no future threat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle told her Trainer that from 
now on, she wanted them to share the 
weight of her resolve together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And together in unison, they loudly 
shouted out the name of their next goal: 
"Tenno Sho (Autumn)"!
